compt.definition:
n. Account; reckoning; computation.
v. t. To compute; to count.
a. Neat; spruce.

comptocormia.translation: [医] 躯干弯曲, 躯干前曲症

compton.definition: n. United States physicist noted for research on x-rays and gamma rays and nuclear energy; his observation that X-rays behave like miniature bowling balls in their interactions with electrons provided evidence for the quantal nature of light (1892-1962)
compton.translation: n. 康普顿（姓氏, 美国城市）

compton effect.translation:
[化] 康普顿效应
[医] 康普顿氏效应

comptonia asplenifolia.translation: [医] 香蕨木, 蕨叶杨梅

comptroller.definition: n someone who maintains and audits business accounts
comptroller.translation:
n. 审计官
[经] 主计, 会计师, 审计

comptrollers.translation: n. 审计员，会计主任( comptroller的名词复数 )
